Welcome to VERSION 1.001

notes.title: Arpsic LAUNCH DAY
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993841/c873ddbcc026ab45fc87fc3a30321fe1345631f8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993841/164a6e508f4f1104687d992128acc4388889d381.png[/img][/url]
Hello!
thank yo so much for buying the game in LAUNCH DAY!
I will be Updating the game Every Month for 1 year, there will be new skins, new songs, the rhythm section will be completed, the free piano version will be completed too, and a lot of new things for the game. So stay alert! I will be posting the new things about the updates here and in the green retroman discord. There you can share your achievements too and your bugs, there are some bugs that will be fixed in a few days. Thank you so much for getting my game I hope you really like it and can achieve that music thery level that you were waiting for. See you in my Discord!
I wont upgrade the proce of my game, it will be the same after every update.
Thanks for getting my game it makes me really really happy to get the game here in steam.

DISCORD LINK
https://discord.gg/C4sf58Gjhm

notes.title: 🎹 KEY DROPS & DEV STREAM 🎹 #SteamNextFest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993841/d7bae58160a62b7f4d20325c8cb173b42af39971.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Join Chris, solo developer, as he plays Arpsic. Ask him anything!

He will be dropping [b]official[/b] Steam keys that will unlock the full game once it is released. If you watch, you may get a [b]free[/b] key ;)

See you all in the stream!

Chris and Jeff

p.s. If you haven't already, you can wishlist Arpsic below, so you don't miss the launch discount.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713340/
